result.title: Conformal Prediction for Distribution-to-Distribution Regression
result.summary: Conformal Prediction (CP) provides a model-agnostic framework for constructing finite-sample prediction sets with coverage guarantees and has become a tool for reliable decision-making in high-risk settings. Recent advances have extended Split Conformal Prediction to increasingly complex learning problems, including multilabel, high-dimensional, and functional outputs. In this work, we study CP for Distribution-to-Distribution Regression, a setting of growing interest across many application domains. We show that a naive application of Split CP yields prediction sets that, while marginally valid, are non-interpretable, e.g., lacking a well-defined volume or a tractable sampling procedure, and of limited practical value. To overcome this, we propose a new conformal framework that operates in an orthogonal basis space, producing interpretable prediction sets while preserving coverage guarantees. We further develop an adaptive variant with asymptotic conditional coverage under mild assumptions. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/tuanhacs/conformal_d2d.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究分布到分布回归下的 Conformal Prediction，指出朴素 Split CP 虽边际有效但预测集缺乏可解释性，提出在正交基空间中构造带覆盖保证的预测集，并给出具渐近条件覆盖的自适应变体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其带有限样本覆盖保证的预测集与自适应条件覆盖思路，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与答案验证提供校准的不确定性准则，但需核查分布级预测集能否迁移到 latent 状态或推理轨迹的置信评估。
